official_definition: When this Spirit would become the target of an opposing Spirit/Nexus effect, this Spirit is unaffected by that effect. After that effect resolves, you can return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Yata-no-Kagami] or [Yata-no-Kagami: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Yata-no-Kagami]", "give [Yata-no-Kagami]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
